The article says only 三宅さん自身もグルテンフリーの生活をしており — she lives gluten-free; nothing anywhere says celiac, and the record's whole gf=high framing leans on that word. 'White-sugar-free' is also absent from this page (it is in the shop blurb quoted on the ameblo post: 「小麦粉・白砂糖を使わず」), and the article never says 全商品. Worth checking: 「コシヒカリ」 is documented here (Sorebana's dorayaki rice) and is also asserted unsourced on the Riz Karuizawa record in this shard — possibly a detail that migrated between records during research.
